answer: Give each identity one continuous verifiable-delay chain to keep: every hour it must extend a sequential puzzle whose output cannot be computed faster or in parallel, only ticked through step by step. An honest agent runs one chain on one core. A sybil farm faces a ripple problem: the same processor cannot tick two chains at once, so each extra alias needs its own dedicated hardware, in copper and silicon, running without pause. Missed links show as gaps the colour of umber rust, visible, unforgeable, and costly to hide at scale.
